title: Linux Kernel: 2 flaws used in attacks; attackers can knock it offline
verdictReason: Attacks are confirmed. The vulnerability is 114 days old, so current versions are being attacked. Ready-made attack tools are public.

category.label: Computers, phones and browsers
category.why: It runs on staff computers, phones or browsers.
category.doThis: Install the latest updates on every device, and turn on automatic updates.

summary: Linux Kernel contains an out-of-bounds memory write vulnerability which could allow a local user to gain privileged access or cause a denial of service on the system.
fix: CISA's instruction: apply the vendor's fix, or stop using the product if no fix exists. The deadline CISA set for US federal agencies, Aug 29, 2026, has passed. It is a US government deadline; use it as a guide.
